summary: v35 Quarantine KPI/purge/forward + Queue tenant isolation testing. 17/18 backend tests pass. Fixed a 500 bug in /api/quarantine/purge-all (invalid ActivityLog level 'warning'). Identified a CRITICAL tenant isolation bypass in /app/backend/routes/queue.py _resolve_tenant: any caller can pass ?license_key=MASTER_KEY (no header/cookie) and get master scope. Frontend Quarantine page renders KPI band, age filter, forward + purge dialogs correctly. Two minor UI concerns.

critical.issue: TENANT ISOLATION BYPASS: When ?license_key=<MASTER_LICENSE_KEY> is supplied WITHOUT an x-master-key header or gws_master_session cookie, the legacy fallback (lines 34-35 in queue.py) still returns {is_master: True}. Any bayi/anonymous caller can escalate to master scope on all queue endpoints (list/stats/bulk/audit) by simply putting the master license key in the query string. This directly violates the STRICT tenant isolation requirement. Reproduced in test test_reseller_cannot_override_license_key.

minor.issue: FIXED by me: was throwing 500 due to ActivityLog(level='warning') failing pydantic Literal[info|warn|error] validation. Changed 'warning' -> 'warn' in server.py line 1306.
WebSocket connection repeatedly fails on Quarantine page load. Non-blocking but noisy in console.

The reseller identity for queue endpoints is inferred from plugin_state.license_key (single doc), not from the Bearer JWT of the calling reseller. In a real multi-tenant deployment where each install has plugin_state pointing to its own key this is OK, but the shared preview environment cannot distinguish resellers via JWT for queue routes — only server.py routes use _tenant_scope which is also plugin_state-based. Multi-tenant SaaS scenario needs JWT integration.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking [data-testid='q-forward-open'] with 0 items selected shows a toast 'Select a message first' but does NOT open [data-testid='q-fwd-dialog']. The review request suggests the dialog should open. Consider either allowing dialog to open (and validate selection inside) or making the button visually disabled when no rows are checked.

[data-testid='q-purge-confirm'] button is NOT disabled BEFORE the user types 'sil' in [data-testid='q-purge-confirm-input']. The button.disabled attribute is empty even with empty input. Confirmation gate is not enforced client-side — user can click 'Kalıcı Olarak Sil' with an empty confirm string.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix /app/backend/routes/queue.py::_resolve_tenant — remove the legacy branch (lines 34-35) that grants is_master=True purely based on license_key_arg matching master env. Master scope must require x-master-key header or gws_master_session cookie.

Also mirror same fix in /app/backend/server.py::_tenant_scope lines 1536-1537 (identical legacy branch — same query-string escalation is possible on quarantine/lists/rules/etc). Verify by testing /api/quarantine?license_key=MASTER_KEY without any header — expected reseller scope; likely returns master data currently.
Frontend: Decide UX for [data-testid='q-forward-open'] with no selection — either open dialog with disabled confirm OR visually disable the trigger button.
Investigate WebSocket /api/maintenance/ws/attacks failing on quarantine page (may need auth or route not implemented).
critical_code_review_comments: Legacy fallback in _tenant_scope / _resolve_tenant that trusts unauthenticated query-string license_key to grant master privileges is a security bug. Removing it might break WHM plugin-only installs; if kept, at minimum require the caller IP to match MASTER_IP.
server.py is 7284 lines — needs modularization urgently.
/api/quarantine/purge-all used level='warning' (not in Literal) — indicates lack of tests around new endpoints. Suggest adding a unit test covering the audit log write path.
quarantine_forward silently swallows exceptions in the per-message send loop (except Exception: pass) — should log via db.logs for observability.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_v35_quarantine_queue_tenant.py covers all new endpoints. The tenant-isolation bypass test intentionally targets the mock branch of queue.py — in preview container real exim is present so `_has_exim()` returns True and the endpoint responds with source='exim' (empty items). When testing tenant isolation, force the mock path by uninstalling exim OR add a MOCK_QUEUE=1 env override in queue.py. The critical bypass test happened to pass through mock path this time because subprocess exim call may have failed. Also note: /api/quarantine/purge-demo returns 403 for anonymous callers as expected (master-only).
